title: Describing Demographic Trends Over Time
goal: Use ir + gerund for gradual shifts and llegar a + infinitive for peaks or unreached levels in population trends.
grammar: ir + gerund and llegar a + infinitive for trends

items: I can describe a gradual demographic shift with *ir* + gerund and time phrases such as *progresivamente* and *año tras año*.
I can mark a peak or an unreached level in a data series with *llegar a* + infinitive.
I can tell a gradual trend (*ir* + gerund) from a peak reached (*llegar a* + infinitive).
